title: Numbered constant
description: One numbered constant a page prints: a row of a name/value table (Flag | Value | Description, Symbolic constant | Value (Hex), ..), a one-cell NAME = 0x0001 / NAME (0x0001) spelling, a #define NAME <number> line of a syntax declaration, a NAME = <number> member of an enum body a syntax declaration quotes, or the NAME (0x0400) / NAME = 0x0400 inline form in running prose.  origin says which.  name and value are as printed; decimal is set only when a decimal column prints a decimal beside the value -- a hexadecimal is never converted.  headers are the header files that same page states (the wider constant -> header linkage, ranked by evidence strength, is derived in kb/constant-headers.tsv).  Example code is never read: #define lines yield constants only from role: "syntax" declarations (sample #defines like '#define cEvents 3' are quarantined).  A constant the page does not number has no record.
